title: Veneered panels and similar laminated wood, with at least one outer ply of tropical wood

review.construction: four Meranti veneers around one purchased edge-jointed Falcata solid-strip core, with crossed physical axes, unfinished faces and both outer plies verified as tropical Meranti
review.classification: The library accepts a narrower CPC 3.0 31422 association for four Meranti veneers around one purchased edge-jointed Falcata solid-strip core, with crossed physical axes, unfinished faces and both outer plies verified as tropical Meranti. The 23 October 2026 UNSD white-cover publication places the corresponding blockboard explicitly in 31422.01 under the standard five-digit parent (Annex, paragraphs 138–143 and printed p.928). The standard 31412 note still expressly includes blockboard and permits other central-core materials. The five physical layers alternate 0/90/0/90/0. Removing the solid core leaves four veneer axes 0/90/90/0. That sequence alone cannot resolve how to read alternate veneer sheets. The specific sectoral child and its parent rule support this limited interpretation alongside that counterevidence. Verify the actual botanical identity and origin of Meranti faces and the purchased Falcata strip core. The CBP sample supports the construction, while this methodology’s UF bonding route and actual producer must be independently documented.
review.competing_evidence: Standard CPC 3.0 31412 continues to name blockboard and to allow central cores of other materials. The core alone or a native dataset label cannot exclude this competing reading. The October expansion independently places these blockboards under the corresponding 3142 parent. The standard 31423 title restricts non-coniferous faces to non-tropical wood. A change in actual wood species, core construction, product state or evidence requires a fresh applicability decision.
review.historical_sources: The November hold, superseded batch-03 evidence, original canonical hashes and original author receipt remain independently traceable. No historical acceptance object is reused for the new edge.
review.study_limits: Verify the actual botanical identity and origin of Meranti faces and the purchased Falcata strip core. The CBP sample supports the construction, while this methodology’s UF bonding route and actual producer must be independently documented.
review.review_scope: This adjudication concerns the classification of the retained, previously substantively reviewed bilingual PCR. The prior production route, accounting, measurement requirements, identified inventory gaps, translation review and candidate lifecycle carry forward.
